svg.title: AstroQuark demo telemetry
svg.desc: Speed, pitch and distance from one Gazebo run. Speed and distance compare Gazebo position with estimates from wheel rotation.
svg.text: Gazebo simulation · ROS 2 measurements · Wheel kinematics
Rover body reaches ramp entry at 7.56 s
Wheel estimates use mean wheel rotation and wheel radius. Gazebo curves use the reference position of the rover body.
The estimated and measured curves can diverge on slopes because of terrain contact and slip.
